newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's CCP rate rises to 19.60 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's CCP rate rises to 19.60 pct in June.

text.p: Mexico's CCP, the average bank term deposit cost measured in pesos in Mexican banks, rose by 1 basis point to 19.60 percent in June from 19.59 percent in May, Banco de Mexico said on Wednesday.

The Banco de Mexico also said that the CCP-UDIs, the CCP measured in UDIs, an inflation indexed investment unit, increased by 12 basis points to 6.90 percent for June, from 6.78 percent the month before.

The Banco de Mexico has said it publishes the various rates in order to give a better idea to the public of the cost of borrowing, and so that banks can only use the reference rates signaled by the central bank, which it hopes will better reflect market conditions.
